children.text: What Is Office LTSC 2024?

Office LTSC 2024 stands for Office Long-Term Servicing Channel 2024. It is Microsoft's latest perpetual-license edition of Office, designed for organizations that need a stable, fixed feature set without ongoing cloud connectivity or subscription renewals.

Unlike Microsoft 365, which receives continuous feature updates and integrates cloud services, Office LTSC 2024 ships with a snapshot of Office features at the time of release. After purchase, you receive only security updates and bug fixes — no new features are added.
This makes LTSC ideal for air-gapped environments, regulated industries, and businesses that prioritize predictability over the latest AI-powered tools.
Office LTSC 2024 vs Office 2024: Key Differences
Both Office LTSC 2024 and the retail
Office 2024
editions are one-time purchases with no subscription. But they target different use cases and come with distinct licensing terms.
Licensing Model

Office LTSC 2024 is sold through Microsoft Volume Licensing agreements. It is deployed using the Office Deployment Tool (ODT) and activated with either a Multiple Activation Key (MAK) or Key Management Service (KMS). Retail Office 2024 editions are purchased individually and activated with a standard product key.
Feature Updates

Retail Office 2024 receives occasional feature updates throughout its lifecycle. Office LTSC 2024 does not — the feature set is frozen at release. You get security patches, but no new capabilities. If you want ongoing feature additions, Microsoft 365 Apps is the right choice.
Cloud Integration

Office LTSC 2024 does not include real-time collaboration, AI-driven automation, or advanced cloud security features found in Microsoft 365. It is designed for environments where devices may be disconnected from the internet for extended periods.
Support Lifecycle
Both Office LTSC 2024 and retail Office 2024 receive five years of Mainstream Support, ending October 9, 2029. After that, there is no Extended Support for either version.
What's New in Office LTSC 2024?
Office LTSC 2024 introduces several improvements over previous LTSC versions while maintaining the stable, fixed-feature approach:
OpenDocument Format 1.4 support in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
Enhanced accessibility tools across all applications
New Office add-ins JavaScript APIs for Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint
Recover session option in Microsoft Word
ActiveX controls disabled by default (admin-re-enableable)
The major version number remains 16.0, ensuring compatibility with existing Group Policy settings and add-ins from Office LTSC 2021 and Office 2019.
What Apps Are Included in Office LTSC 2024?
Office LTSC Professional Plus 2024 includes the following applications:
Word
Excel
PowerPoint
Outlook
OneNote
Access
Skype for Business is available as an optional install during setup. Microsoft Teams is not preinstalled but can be downloaded separately.
Notably,
Microsoft Publisher is not included
in Office LTSC 2024. Microsoft retired Publisher support after October 2026, so it was excluded from this release.
Office LTSC Professional Plus vs Standard
Microsoft offers two editions of Office LTSC 2024:
Office LTSC Professional Plus 2024
Includes Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, OneNote, and
Access
. This is the most comprehensive LTSC edition, designed for IT professionals, businesses, and power users who need database capabilities.
Office LTSC Standard 2024
Includes Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and OneNote — but
no Access
. This edition suits freelancers, small offices, and teams that do not need database tools.
Mac Compatibility
Office LTSC Standard for Mac 2024 is available for volume-licensed customers. Access is not available on macOS.
Who Should Buy Office LTSC 2024?
Office LTSC 2024 is not for everyone. It is designed for specific scenarios where stability and offline capability matter more than the latest features.
Best For
Regulated industries (healthcare, finance, government) that restrict cloud connectivity
Air-gapped networks where devices cannot reach the internet
Organizations that need a fixed, predictable feature set with no UI changes
Businesses that prefer one-time licensing over subscription costs
Users who want Microsoft Access without a Microsoft 365 subscription
Not Ideal For
Individuals who want the latest Office features as they release
Teams that rely on real-time collaboration and cloud services
Users who need Mac support with Access (not available on macOS)
Small businesses that prefer Microsoft 365's bundled cloud storage and collaboration tools
System Requirements for Office LTSC 2024
Before purchasing Office LTSC 2024, verify your system meets the minimum requirements:
Operating System: Windows 11, Windows 10 LTSC 2019/2021, or Windows Server 2022/2025
Processor: 1.1 GHz, two-core
RAM: 4 GB
Disk Space: 4 GB available
Display: 1280 x 768 resolution (64-bit required for 4K+)
For Mac users, Office LTSC Standard for Mac 2024 is available, but Access is not included on macOS.
How to Deploy Office LTSC 2024
Deployment of Office LTSC 2024 follows the same process as previous volume-licensed Office versions:
Download the Office Deployment Tool (ODT) from Microsoft
Create a configuration file specifying your edition and activation method
Run the ODT to download and install Office LTSC 2024
Activate using MAK or KMS depending on your licensing agreement
Internet connectivity is required for MAK activation but not for KMS activation. Once activated, Office LTSC 2024 can be used fully offline.
Office LTSC 2024 Pricing

Microsoft's official pricing for Office LTSC 2024 varies by region and licensing agreement. Through Volume Licensing, organizations typically pay per-device fees. Retail pricing for Office LTSC Professional Plus 2024 generally ranges from $400 to $600 depending on the reseller.

Office LTSC 2024 vs Microsoft 365: Which Should You Choose?
The choice between Office LTSC 2024 and
Microsoft 365
comes down to how you want to pay and what features you need.
Choose
Office LTSC 2024
if you want a one-time purchase, do not need cloud features, and prefer a fixed feature set that never changes.
Choose
Microsoft 365
if you want the latest features, cloud collaboration, 1 TB of OneDrive storage, and the ability to install Office on multiple devices.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can individuals buy Office LTSC 2024?
Yes. While LTSC is often marketed to enterprises, anyone can purchase it. It is a good choice for individuals who want a one-time purchase without subscriptions.
Does Office LTSC 2024 include Publisher?
No. Microsoft Publisher is not included in Office LTSC 2024. Microsoft retired Publisher support after October 2026.
How long is Office LTSC 2024 supported?
Office LTSC 2024 receives five years of Mainstream Support, ending October 9, 2029. There is no Extended Support.
Can I upgrade from Office LTSC 2021 to Office LTSC 2024?
There is no direct upgrade path. You must uninstall previous versions and deploy Office LTSC 2024 as a fresh installation using the Office Deployment Tool.
Does Office LTSC 2024 work on Windows 10?
Office LTSC 2024 supports Windows 10 LTSC 2019 and 2021, as well as Windows 11. However, note that Windows 10 standard editions reach end of support in October 2025.
